title: A Report of the Operations at Franklin
author: Emerson Opdycke
note: Primary account from a Union brigade commander used for assault timing and pike-sector action.

title: For Cause and for Country: A Study of the Battle of Franklin
author: R. Jacobson
note: Modern battle study used for sequence alignment, terrain interpretation, and Carter House sector analysis.

title: Atlas to Accompany the Official Records
author: U.S. War Department
note: Cartographic reference for Harpeth River crossings and road geometry context.

title: The Army of Tennessee
author: Stanley F. Horn
note: Narrative synthesis used for interpretation of evening counterattacks and local reserve actions.

title: The Battle of Franklin, Tennessee
author: O. Edward Cunningham
note: Detailed operational account used for late-evening attrition and collapse-of-momentum interpretation.

title: Co. Aytch: A Side Show of the Big Show
author: Sam R. Watkins
note: Memoir of a private in the 1st Tennessee Infantry, present at Franklin. Quoted for first-person accounts of the assault, the darkness, and the field afterward.

title: The Battle of Franklin, Tennessee
author: John K. Shellenberger
note: Account by a captain of the 64th Ohio, in Conrad's brigade of Wagner's advanced line. Read as a paper in 1902; published 1916. Quoted for the forward position, the rout, and the fight at the works.

title: A Sketch of the Battle of Franklin, Tenn.; with Reminiscences of Camp Douglas
author: John M. Copley
note: Memoir of a private in the 49th Tennessee, captured at the cotton gin. Quoted for the Confederate ranks before the advance.

title: Cleburne and His Command
author: Irving A. Buck
note: Cleburne's adjutant, absent wounded from Franklin, who gathered the accounts of Brig. Gen. Daniel C. Govan and others. Source for the Winstead Hill exchange.

title: Advance and Retreat: Personal Experiences in the United States and Confederate States Armies
author: John Bell Hood
note: Hood's own account of the campaign, quoted for the decision to attack at Franklin.

title: History of the Thirty-sixth Regiment Illinois Volunteers, During the War of the Rebellion
author: L. G. Bennett and William M. Haigh
note: Regimental history of a Union regiment on the field, quoted for how the advance sounded from behind the works.

title: Franklin: battle summary and 10 Facts
author: American Battlefield Trust
note: Modern reference used for casualty totals and for quotations whose original publication is a periodical or regimental paper not reproduced here.
